description: Preview output on screen: turn Overprint Preview on or off, open the Separations Preview or Flattener Preview panel, show all plates or a single cyan, magenta, yellow, black or spot plate, and show single plates in black or desaturate black (View > Overprint Preview; Window > Output > Separations Preview and its panel menu; Window > Output > Flattener Preview)

desaturateBlack.description: Show black as dark grey to tell rich black from plain black (Desaturate Black)

flattenerPanel.description: Open (true) or close (false) the Flattener Preview panel, which highlights areas transparency flattening affects

overprintPreview.description: Simulate overprinting in the document window (View > Overprint Preview)

plate.description: Show every plate, or one plate alone (spot_1 is the first spot ink)

separationsPanel.description: Open (true) or close (false) the Separations Preview panel

singlePlatesInBlack.description: Show single plates in black rather than their ink colour (Show Single Plates in Black)

name: set_output_preview
title: Set Output Preview
